subject: luna-meadows
label: The parasol is her grandmother's
from: A running feud with a raccoon
to: Her late grandmother's parasol, pursued three times a week forever
note:
Luna was emotionally abandoned by her parents and raised by her grandmother, who is dead. The parasol Sir Trashmuffin stole on sight belonged to her. Luna tries to get it back AT LEAST THREE TIMES A WEEK and has never once decided it is not worth it.

She was drawn to chaos because it was the opposite of that rigid house — and kept the FORM while discarding every rule: candles, tarot, the witching hour, all of it authored by her. She took Fairbrooks University's CRYPTID CLASSES after a four-month hyperfixation, which puts a trained cryptozoologist on all three of Arc 3's camping trips. Favourite holiday: Samhain, when the veil is thinnest.
